messages:
Morgan: Quick heads-up — SlateChip reached out with a limited preview of their new board. They want a short scaling probe this week, plus a joint Marketplace trajectory (AWS/GCP) and press sync. NDA attached. Need to coordinate bench, telemetry, and embargo timing. Thoughts?

Raj: Thanks — got the HW specs. I'll validate the driver stack and kernel requirements. Planning to spin a couple nodes tomorrow. What's the expected max sequence length for their perf tests?

Ellie: Product requests p99 latency at seq=1024 and throughput numbers for batch sizes 1 / 8 / 32. Use the same eval dataset we use for other silicon partners so apples-to-apples. Also: no public numbers until legal signs off on any press.

Leo: Marketing note: embargo window should be 2 weeks post-report to give us time to craft co-branded assets. We need at least 3 business days to prep the marketplace listing collateral if we greenlight a joint announcement. Please confirm marketplace SKU/packaging format (AMI vs container).

Morgan: @Raj can you add a runbook note for kernel/CUDA versions? Also we need the NDA signed before any external screenshots or graphs leave the preview group — link (internal): https://redwood.company/nda/slatechip-preview

Raj: Will do. Preliminary stack required: Linux 6.2+, CUDA 12.2, cuDNN 9. I'll run both bf16 and int8/quantized paths. Posting my planned command here for reproducibility: 

```
bench-run --model slate-v1 --seq 1024 --batch 1,8,32 --dtype bf16 --k8s-replicas 2 --telemetry on
```

I'll upload raw outputs to GCS when done.

Morgan: Ellie — can you drop the eval set and prompt templates into the partner bucket? Also @Ana (Legal) — can you confirm the NDA text allows publishing partner-approved derived benchmark numbers? We should lock that before any public claims.

InfraBot: Deploy job 9845 started: provisioning 2 instances in us-west2. ETA ~18m.

Raj: Quick smoke: kernel modules loaded cleanly. Early look: ~12% perf delta vs our internal reference at seq=1024 batch=8 (bf16). Uploading raw CSV now: gs://redwood-slatechip/probe-2073456789/raw.csv. Will run the full sweep overnight.

Ellie: Thanks. Let's do a 30-minute sync tomorrow 10:00 AM PT to review the full numbers. If the perf delta is <=15% we proceed to marketplace packaging; if >15% we open an engineering triage with SlateChip and request HW/firmware tuning.

Leo: I'll start a 2-slide co-brand PR deck and an embargoed 1-paragraph release template. Need SVG logos and the exact marketplace SKU name.

Morgan: Action items recap: Raj — full probe + upload raw; Ellie — provide eval dataset + templates; Leo — draft embargo assets + SKU suggestion; Ana — confirm NDA/publication permission. I've added a calendar invite for tomorrow 10am PT. Meeting to reconvene after the run. :thumbsup:

Raj: Noted, will post final numbers to the thread when complete.

Morgan: Thanks all. Keeping this thread as our single source of truth for the preview run; please avoid splicing info into other threads.
